summary:
Implementation plan for the Daily First-Open Roadmap (4-Screen Morning Routine):
1. Welcome Screen
2. Days Left Countdown Page
3. Collecting Yesterday's Metrics (Sleep & Screen Time)
4. Consistency Broken / Absence Debrief (if applicable) transitioning directly into Yesterday's Analysis with AI Coach evaluation.
Fixes the rollover modal premature closure bug and links all existing screens into a seamless sequential daily workflow.
